about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Mass of the First Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. This formulary serves the weekdays of that week. On the Sunday itself the feast of the Holy Family takes its place. The same prayer is used in the formularies of Sexagesima and the Second Sunday of Lent.

seg.tr: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that You would graciously grant us, whom You refresh with Your sacraments, to serve You also by conduct pleasing to You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: You may graciously allow those whom You refresh with Your sacraments to serve You also by pleasing conduct
who lives and reigns with You
